create.name: Elspeth Lewis
create.bio:
Elspeth Lewis is a mindfulness coach and sound bath practitioner in Edinburgh who works with adults, teenagers, groups and workplaces, in person and online, under the name Pause to Be. She trained as a mindfulness teacher in 2019 with Shamash Alidina, then added Acceptance and Commitment Training, including its adolescent form with Russ Harris and the DNA-v youth model with Louise Hayes and Joseph Ciarrochi. In 2023 she qualified with the Sound Healing Academy to hold group sound baths, and she keeps a daily formal practice of her own alongside regular retreats.

Her coaching teaches simple, practical skills: mindful breathing, the body scan, gentle mindful movement, and ways of meeting difficult thoughts and feelings with acceptance rather than struggle, so that people can find more calm and clarity and act on what matters to them. She leads evening and weekend sound baths in Corstorphine and Swanston that open with breathing and a short meditation. Her book Smooth Sailing with Your Teen brings mindful parenting to the years of adolescence, and she contributed chapters to two community collections by mindfulness teachers. She has also designed a deck of values cards for mindful goal-setting.

courses.title: Mindfulness Coaching
